div.span: STAGE 5: BANK UTR CONFIRMATION & SETTLEMENT
STAGE 4: SUPER ADMIN / CRM AUDIT QUEUE
STAGE 3: WITHDRAWAL REQUEST & BALANCE LOCK
STAGE 2: BANK ACCOUNT OR UPI VERIFICATION
STAGE 1: SERVICE COMPLETION & ESCROW CLEARANCE
Option A: Approved for Payout
Option B: Rejected - Wrong IFSC or Dispute

Bank Generates Transaction Reference
Unique Bank UTR Ref: UTR20261123987

Corporate Bank Transfer
Finance team disburses ₹10,000 via NEFT / IMPS / UPI

Super Admin Marks as Paid
Inputs Bank UTR Number in CRM Dashboard
POST /api/wallet-payouts/admin/process-payout

Platform Ledger: PAYOUT_DISBURSEMENT
Associated booking items marked as Settled

Real-time Notification to Provider:
₹10,000 successfully settled to your bank! UTR: UTR20261123987

Super Admin & CRM Finance Queue
GET /api/wallet-payouts/admin/payouts
Audits provider KYC, completed appointments & bank details

Provider Clicks Request Payout
Enters Amount (e.g. ₹10,000 - Minimum: ₹500)
POST /api/wallet-payouts/request-payout

Balance Guard & Escrow Lock
Validates balance and reserves ₹10,000
Prevents double spending

Provider Registers Settlement Destination
Direct Bank Transfer (A/C No, IFSC) or Instant UPI

Service Provider Fulfills Appointment
Example: Vet Consultation or Grooming Session Completed

Provider Dashboard: Changes Status to Completed
PATCH /api/bookings/:id/status

Automated Escrow Release Engine
settlementStatus: Pending moves to Available
Net 95% shifts to Available Payout Balance

Safety Release & Restoration
Reserved ₹10,000 unlocked back to Available Balance
Provider receives error note with correction prompt
